description: COMBINE the current best (brief 21 HEAD 250a694c, 4394us — has the n=4096 cluster path but runs n=2048 B=8 on the SINGLE-CTA panel) with brief 20's n=2048->cluster routing (8f4c188f): brief 20 measured n=2048 B=8 goes 19197us (single-CTA, only 8 CTAs on 148 SMs = work-starved) -> 15240us = 1.26x by routing it onto the cooperative cluster panel with K=8 (lower K at higher batch — the K-by-batch law: n=4096 B=2 wants K=16, n=2048 B=8 wants K=8). COMBINE parent A best (250a694c) + parent B n=2048->cluster routing (8f4c188f). Minimal routing change: add 2048 to _CLUSTER_N, _cluster_k_for returns K=8 for n=2048 (K=16 for n=4096), mhyb=256. CUDA byte-identical + runtime path identical to trial 1 (K=8/mhyb=256), so metric = trial-1 clean fast-mode min 4358.27us. Re-validated final file: 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN. nsys (trial-2 SHA, n2048): panel_factor_cluster_kernel still dominant ~66%, TF32 trailing GEMMs ~28%, single-CTA short-trailing panel<512> ~8%. NOTE: fleet in sustained bimodal SLOW-mode (~9100us, every shape ~2x, code-independent) for the latter half of the run -- those reads are contention noise, not config signal.

COMBINE DONE: routed n=2048 B=8 onto the cooperative cluster panel (K=8, mhyb=256) on top of parent A's best, keeping n=4096(K=16)/n=512/n=1024/tiny-n/n=352 EXACTLY as parent A. RESULT: geomean min-of-3 (clean fast-mode) 4358.27us = 1.0082x over parent A (4394.12); n=2048 shape5 ~19197(single-CTA)->15152us as parent B predicted. 22 tests + 3 guards CLEAN incl n=2048 dense/rankdef/mixed on the cluster.
